THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
SCULPTED DRAMA
021
24 / Crimson Garden
A dramatic over-the-shoulder portrait in a flowing
crimson dress with a red floral collar, long straight black hair and
a glossy burgundy crocodile-leather shoulder bag. Lush green
shrubs and a soft fountain blur the background.
25 / Scarlet Cut
A graphic profile against a solid scarlet backdrop: long
sleek black hair, a black halter garment with a bare back, long
black leather opera gloves and a pair of steel scissors held up
near the shoulder.
